admin.title: Cash assets
admin.lead: Assets are identified by mint address. Tickers can be faked. A new asset is verified on-chain and stays disabled until you enable it.
admin.empty: No assets yet. Add the first mint address.
admin.unreachableBody: The registrar API is not answering right now. Try again in a moment.

addDialog.title: Add asset by mint address
addDialog.lead: Paste the mint address. Qupon reads the account on-chain and fills the verified fields.
addDialog.mintHint: The token's on-chain address, not its ticker.
addDialog.mintError: Enter a valid base58 Solana address
addDialog.symbolHint: Display only. Holders always see the mint address.
addDialog.name: Name
addDialog.noteHint: Shown to investors, e.g. the custodian behind a wrapped asset.
addDialog.enableNow: Enable now (issuers can use it for new series)
addDialog.acceptFreeze: I understand this mint can be frozen by its authority and accept the risk

toggle.confirmTitle: This mint has a freeze authority
toggle.confirmBody: The issuer of this token can freeze token accounts. Enable it only if you trust the authority.

custodian.title: Wrapped digital tenge custodian
custodian.lead: The custodian holds digital tenge (CBDC) and wraps it 1:1 as dKZT for bond settlements. Record a deposit reference to mint, or a withdrawal to burn.
custodian.simulatedBody: The custodian is a simulation for the demo: there is no real CBDC bridge. Movements wrap the devnet dKZT test asset only and are audited like every other write.
custodian.unreachableBody: The registrar API is not answering right now. Try again in a moment.

dialog.title: Custodian movement (SIMULATED)
dialog.lead: A deposit mints {symbol} to an issuer treasury; a withdrawal burns it from the platform treasury.
dialog.referenceHint: The deposit or withdrawal reference from the (simulated) CBDC system.
dialog.toHint: The issuer wallet that receives the wrapped tokens.
dialog.toError: Enter a valid base58 Solana address
dialog.simulatedNote: SIMULATED: no real CBDC moves. The reference is only recorded in the transaction memo and the audit ledger.
